KSLU Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for 31 Assistant Professor and Guest Faculty Posts - Complete Details

The Karnataka State Law University (KSLU) Recruitment 2026 for posts of 31 Assistant Professor and Guest Faculty. The online application closes on 25-09-2026. The candidate shall apply online through KSLU website, kslu.karnataka.gov.in.

Important Dates

  • Last Date : 25 September 2026
  • Notification date : 17 September 2026
  • Last date for receipt of application : 25 September 2026
  • Interview date : To be communicated later

Application Fee

  • Post Names : Temporary Full-Time Assistant Professor and Guest Faculty
  • Assistant Professor Salary : ₹50,000 per month
  • Guest Faculty Remuneration : ₹450 or ₹525 per hour, depending on qualification/category
  • Last Date : 25 September 2026
  • Last date for receipt of application : 25 September 2026
  • Post : Subject
  • Temporary Full-Time Assistant Professor : Law
  • Temporary Full-Time Assistant Professor : Management
  • Temporary Full-Time Assistant Professor : Political Science
  • Temporary Full-Time Assistant Professor : Sociology
  • Guest Faculty : Law
  • Post/Category : Remuneration
  • Temporary Full-Time Assistant Professor : ₹50,000 per month as consolidated pay
  • UGC-qualified Guest Faculty with NET/SLET/SET/Ph.D. : ₹525 per hour
  • Non-UGC-qualified Guest Faculty with a Master’s degree and 55% marks : ₹450 per hour
  • Local conveyance for Guest Faculty : ₹150 per day

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
